newsitem.title: USA: IVI investor Mills has 5.3 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: IVI investor Mills has 5.3 pct stake.

text.p: IVI Publishing Inc said Wednesday that private investor Wayne Mills purchased 400,000 common shares, or 5.3 percent, of the company's outstanding stock.
It said Mills told the company he will not seek a seat on the board and his investment is a passive one.
IVI said Mills and his wife confirmed the stock purchases in a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. The purchases were made between July 24 and October 2.
IVI is an electronic publisher of health and medical information for the consumer, education and professional medical markets.
